verses.text: The LORD is my shepherd; I have all that I need.
He lets me rest in green meadows; he leads me beside peaceful streams.
He renews my strength. He guides me along right paths, bringing honor to his name.
through the darkest valley, I will not be afraid, for you are close beside me. Your rod and your staff protect and comfort me.
in the presence of my enemies. You honor me by anointing my head with oil. My cup overflows with blessings.
all the days of my life, and I will live in the house of the LORD forever.
